instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Onboarding card: LessonLoop Review Desk is the working project name. Teachers submit lesson plans and track whether they are waiting, approved, or returned. Department Coordinators assign submitted plans to Curriculum Reviewers. Curriculum Reviewers add feedback and approve or return only the plans assigned to them. Teachers write the lesson content themselves, so automatic lesson-content creation is not included. The business objective is not stated on this card.
